_experiment.scientific_factor: R08 closed no-MSA core + only parent-anchored non-dominant residual authority closure. Pair-conditioned atom, distogram and smooth-lDDT are all off, so this isolates the shared MF->R05 authority-boundary hypothesis that was exposed by the v167 late-training diagnostics.
r05_invariants: legacy R05 sequence path and per-round CE semantics

representation_semantics.single: explicit local single state s_i = projected R05 hidden + corrected 4-head residue-atom attention over canonical atom slots + flow-time + role + PCS-RC proposal condition + detached recurrent single state
representation_semantics.pair: proposal-anchored triangle-closed local z_ij over every design/paratope residue plus the nearest 18 PCS-RC antigen-context residues; learned relative position, current/proposal CA geometry, and slot-resolved canonical atom14xatom14 Gaussian geometry are retained before compression; native H3 AA-pair identity is excluded to prevent target leakage
representation_semantics.graph_integration: final triangle-refined z_ij still enters the SAME legacy R05 EGNN node+coordinate mechanics, but the projected pair edge residual is locally RMS-bounded not to exceed the already-computed parent R05 edge message; dynamic KNN and the sole EGNN coordinate decoder are unchanged.
representation_semantics.sequence_integration: legacy R05 sequence logits remain the parent authority; enriched-single -> 20-AA residual remains trainable but is locally RMS-bounded to non-dominance after removing the softmax-irrelevant per-residue logit gauge.
representation_semantics.coordinate_decoder: original R05 equivariant coordinate engine remains the only coordinate decoder
representation_semantics.coordinate_units: R05 model-frame coordinates are scaled by 0.1, so representation geometry RBF centers use 0.2-2.2 model units corresponding to physical 2-22 A; distogram labels remain physical 2-22 A on native coordinates
representation_semantics.pair_reasoning: one no-MSA closed block: AbX-style OPM supplies single->pair communication; then MF Pairformer ordering applies triangle multiplication out/in, triangle attention start/end, pair transition, and finally pair-biased single attention + single transition. Thus each block is single -> pair -> relational reasoning -> single in the same R05 round.
representation_semantics.recycling: detached s/z representation-state carry only across the existing three evolving R05 physical rounds; this is explicitly not MF fixed-input latent recycling. No nested recycle loop and no derived previous-clean history summary.
representation_semantics.triangle_autograd: Triangle/OPM mathematics unchanged; only re-entrant activation checkpointing is disabled under torch1.11 DDP. Dynamic used-parameter discovery is enabled because the triangle-to-loss route can be batch-dependent through dynamic R05 EGNN edges and detached recycle.
representation_semantics.allatom_geometry: AbX-semantic slot-resolved atom14xatom14 distance field: 196 canonical atom-slot Gaussian features with trainable slot-pair coefficients are chunked and compressed; unlike AbX, coefficients are not conditioned on native H3 AA-pair identity, avoiding sequence-target leakage.
representation_semantics.atom_level: Pair-conditioned atom refinement is OFF in R11 so the authority intervention is tested on the exact R08 closed-core parent before reintroducing the empirically useful MF-style z->atom-pair pathway.
representation_semantics.authority_closure: Parent-anchored non-dominant RMS trust region at all three direct MF->R05 bridges: (1) single_to_base residual <= parent H0 RMS per local token; (2) pair edge residual <= legacy R05 edge-message RMS per EGNN edge; (3) centered single_to_seq_logits residual <= centered legacy R05 logit RMS per residue. The fixed bound is exactly 1.0 by definition of non-dominance and is not a tuned hyperparameter.

formal_runtime.validation: exact DDP logical-batch sharding with EMA
formal_runtime.ddp_batch_partition: cost-balanced within each shuffled global batch; preserves global batch sample multiset and 28 samples/rank while balancing whole-residue + local-token^3 compute/memory proxy
formal_runtime.triangle_local_universe: all design residues + up to 18 PCS-RC-nearest antigen residues per complex; dense/triangle-closed only inside this bounded local set
formal_runtime.ddp_graph_contract: torch1.11 dynamic graph: triangle activation checkpoint off; DDP static_graph off; find_unused_parameters on
formal_runtime.authority_contract: parameter-free parent non-dominance at every direct MF->R05 bridge; cap coefficient is definitionally 1.0, not tuned

loss_hierarchy.rationale: R11 keeps the full R08 scientific loss hierarchy unchanged (sequence/structure/interface/edge all 1.0; distogram and smooth-lDDT off). The only intervention is the hybrid-specific parent-anchored non-dominant residual interface, isolating whether unbounded modern residual takeover is a common cause of late free-generation degradation.

_experiment.representation_fidelity: v164 task-consistent donor fusion: AbX supplies explicit single->pair OPM semantics; MF supplies pair-first Pairformer z->single readback; both are adapted to the bounded proposal-anchored triangle-closed universe. Final z directly conditions the sole R05 EGNN node+coordinate mechanics. The optional geometry auxiliary is a design-region factored MF/Boltz smooth-lDDT adaptation, not an H3-specific loss. Intentional donor differences: no MSA/ESM, no native design-AA leakage, no IPA or AF3 AtomAttentionDecoder second coordinate authority, no EDM sampler and no nested fixed-input recycle. R11 intentionally removes pair-atom relative to the retired v168 single-run proposal so that the authority intervention can first be tested on the exact R08 closed-core parent.
_experiment.runtime_bugfix: Retains the v164 pair-universe ordering fix and v167 diagnostic fixes. v169 changes only the formal causal experiment ladder/configuration around the already implemented v168 authority operator.
